review:
The buffalo on a Megaways grid, with an extra horizontal reel on top for even more ways. The buffalo wild carries a 2x multiplier every time.

In free spins, a random multiplier from 2x to 25x is picked at the start and applies to every win for the whole round – so that first draw sets the mood. Very high volatility, 6,000x max and 96.75% RTP, with free spins around once every 136 spins, more often than the original.
pros: Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 136 spins on average)
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
